observations: Blue closed-head drum with two white bung caps on top.
Label clearly reads "SODIUM HYDROXIDE SOLUTION" with corrosive hazard diamond and UN 1823.
Watermark "DEJOE GLOBAL SERVICES" overlaid on both images.
Drum shows scuffs, dirt, and minor surface wear.
No legible volume or concentration marking visible on the label.

claims.evidence: Label reads "SODIUM HYDROXIDE SOLUTION" in photo 0 and photo 1.
Sodium hydroxide is caustic soda; label confirms sodium hydroxide solution in photo 0 and photo 1.
Drum shape is typical but volume is not legible on the label in either photo.
Quality cannot be assessed from photos alone.

risks.risk: The drum may be empty or may not contain sodium hydroxide solution.
risks.proof: Video of opening the bung and showing the liquid inside, or a certificate of analysis.
risks.if_unproven: price as an empty used drum.

risks.risk: Concentration or purity is unknown and may be below industrial standard.
risks.proof: Close-up of the label showing concentration percentage, or an SDS/CoA document.

risks.risk: The drum may leak or have structural damage to the body, seams, or bungs.
risks.proof: Video panning over the drum body, seams, and bung areas to check for dents, rust, or seepage.
risks.if_unproven: price as a damaged or leaking drum.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the full label to read volume and concentration.
Video showing the drum is sealed and contains liquid.
Close-up inspection of the drum body for leaks, dents, or rust.
response.reason: The item is identifiable from the label as a drum of sodium hydroxide solution, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified contents and condition.
